audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer says 'Akshan' on all seven, and the packet levelChart is Akshan x7. The page renders two different answers.
audit.why: Emerald+ win rate is 52.97% over 993 games and Brand has zero mobility, no dash and no escape versus a ranged champion with a wall-swing. Akshan is favoured at every stage; nothing in either kit produces a Brand power window in lane.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side all set to Akshan, matching win[0..6] and the packet chart. Difficulty stays EVEN-leaning-Akshan at 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why contains a garbled fragment ('Avengerang... no —') and calls Akshan's R 'Vengeance'. The R is Comeuppance. spikes[0].text calls Heroic Swing a dash onto Brand and invents a stun for Akshan.
audit.why: Akshan R is Comeuppance (100/85/70s, 2500 range, missing-health execute). Akshan E is a grapple into terrain, not a targeted dash, and Akshan has no stun in his kit — the only stun in this lane is Brand's Sear on an ablaze target.
audit.corrected: Spikes named correctly: level 3 full kit, level 6 Comeuppance execute, first item (Youmuu's/Serylda's) closing speed, late pick threat. Real cooldowns cited: Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is stated only glancingly. Sear stuns ONLY when the target is already ablaze — that is the whole matchup, and it is buried in one breakdown line while spikes[0] claims Akshan stuns.
audit.why: Brand's Blaze comes from any spell contact. Once you are ablaze, his 1050-range Sear becomes a stun and his full rotation lands. If you are clean, Sear is only damage. Pillar of Flame (900 range, 8-10s) is his usual ablaze applicator because it is his safest range. Conflagration is only 625 range — he has to walk into your auto range to use it as an opener.
audit.corrected: Rule stated plainly: stay clean, and when W does clip you, break line of sight or hold the swing for the Sear that follows. Punish the 625-range E: if he opens with Conflagration he is inside your string range with no dash out.
sources: enemyKit Q text ('If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun')

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames entries flag 'Pillar of Flame' as a probable wrong name. It is Brand's real W name in the kit file. False positive — no edit made.

edits.before: Avengerang... no — R online: Vengeance executes the chipped from two screens. Chip, then channel.
edits.after: R online: Comeuppance stores bullets and executes the chipped from 2500 range. Chip him, then channel.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by clipping you with Pillar of Flame first, so his 1050-range Sear stuns instead of grazing and the rotation kills.

edits.before: Ahead, bully harder: string Brand off every contact, swing-roam the rivers, and execute the map's mistakes with R.
edits.after: Ahead, deny him stacks: he has no dash, so hold him off the wave with strings and swing in the moment his Sear flies wide.

edits.before: Carry through strings and executes — chip everything, finish anything under a third, and let the swing write angles no one wards.
edits.after: Carry by never being ablaze when Sear flies — clean strings, break line of sight on his 1050 poke, and execute him with R from behind a wall.

edits.before: If Brand opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sear (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q strings and stay relevant through R executes.
edits.after: If Brand opens the score, his W alone chunks you — farm outside 900 range with Q, never let Blaze reach three stacks, and take only the trades that start with his Sear already on cooldown.

edits.before: Once you have Q-W-E online you can dash in with E, unload Q's on the stun, and get out before Brand can land a second Pillar of Flame.
edits.after: With Q-W-E online, swing off a wall to close, land the boomerang's out-and-back, and leave before his 10s Pillar of Flame comes back up.

edits.before: Serylda's/Youmuu's spike gives you the burst and mobility to punish Brand's animation-locked combo before Ablaze stacks tick you down.
edits.after: Serylda's/Youmuu's gives you the burst and speed to reach him the moment W lands, leaving his 8s Sear as the only answer he still holds.

notes: Packet suspectNames flagged 'Pillar of Flame' twice in wants.you[0]/wants.foe[0]; it is Brand's correct W name — false positive, no edit. Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows (Skill vs Akshan); proposed as one atomic group on the full side only, since win[0..6] already read Akshan and needs no change. Left breakdown.wave and breakdown.mid templated: nothing in Brand's kit gives a matchup-specific wave interaction beyond what breakdown.early already says, and inventing one would be worse than leaving it.
